en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing three hikers on a rocky outcrop overlooking a forested valley in the Ciucaș Mountains. A winding track leads to a lone mountain chalet in a clearing. Caption at top left reads "MUNTII CIUCAȘ – Cabana "Muntele Roșu"". The reverse has Romanian printing from the People's Republic era, handwritten message and address, and Bucharest postmarks.
